description: An access denied (403) page block for Svelte 5: it names the report and the missing permission, shows the signed-in account with SvAvatar and email beside a Switch account SvButton, and lets the user request access. Request access opens an optional SvTextArea note with a character count, sending shows loading and a toast, and a pending SvBadge replaces the form.

faq.question: How does the request flow work?
faq.answer: A stage state moves from idle to writing when you press Request access, which shows the SvTextArea and Send request. Sending shows loading, fires a success toast and moves to sent, where a pending badge explains who has to approve.

faq.question: How do I send the request to my backend?
faq.answer: Pass an onRequest option to createAccessRequest that POSTs the resource, permission and note to your access-request endpoint. The core moves the stage to sent when it resolves and stays on the note form if it rejects.

faq.question: How does it fit on a phone?
faq.answer: Below 480 px the card padding shrinks and the account row wraps so Switch account sits under the email instead of squeezing it.
